sentinels.note: superseded by sentinels_serial; first-measure single run kept for the record

sentinels_concurrent.verdict: Concurrency adds no process time: same-tree, same-session medians over 5 runs each, concurrent 1875.0 / 1843.8 vs serial 1953.1 / 1781.2 (spawns 43). Per-step process_ms is the same serial and concurrent (cold python per step); the cost is in sentinel-check-plugin-drift (531-625ms, 20 spawns) and sentinel-forwarder-drift (547-703ms, 9 spawns), both coordinator/bin scripts outside this row's footprint. The pinned before (1593.8) is one low draw; the base sha re-measured as 5 runs from an export of c89663d57a gives median 1703.1 (1625.0-1718.8, 41 spawns), and live-tree serial reads 1780-1950, so the pinned figure is reproduced by neither tree. Bar vs the pinned single draw stays open and is not re-pinned; it closes only by cutting the two drift sentinels.
